title: Preparation, events and assessments
intro: Optional evidence for this record. Preparation, execution and scientific outcomes are recorded separately.
sharing: Includes writing, contributors, tags, figures and all preparation, event and assessment facts on this record. Select media separately. Linked private records, evidence and analyses stay private.
empty: No structured preparation or events recorded.
applicabilityHelp: State which attempt, stage or later acquisitions use this revision. Existing events and assessments retain their original preparation.
inputs: Configuration, source, image and calibration identities
name: Name
label: Label
circumstances: Circumstances, including accidental attempts or reused media
eventHelp: Recording a host job, preparation check or acquisition does not establish physical execution or a successful scientific outcome. Several acquisitions can belong to the same attempt.
assessmentHelp: Assess one criterion against its selected preparation revision. Enter exact values and the applicable denominator. Observanda does not calculate an outcome or reinterpret the number base.
draftHelp: Review this addition, then save the record. Saved facts remain inspectable; amendments and corrections are new entries.
invalid: Complete the required fields and references. Use an exact hash, identify inherited conditions, and give amendments and assessments a reason.
changed: The record or workspace changed. Reopen this form from the current record.
conflict: These attempt revisions conflict. Saved facts cannot be replaced. Review both versions, keep the saved facts, then add an amendment or correction. Cancel keeps your unfinished edits.
wait: Finish selecting the reference before adding this item.
notAssessedYet: No assessment recorded for this criterion.
restoreNote: Restoring earlier writing keeps all recorded preparations, events and assessments. Correct these by adding an amendment or correction.
different: Differs from the first run on this page
same: Matches the first run on this page
missing: Missing from the first run on this page
missingHere: Not present in this preparation; present in the first run on this page
outsideConditionWindow: Not matched in the displayed condition window
